title: Surat Penawaran / Quotation (K2)
description: The document the server stores and the PDF renders, in either locale. Sent to Muse Spark 1.3 with text.format {type: json_schema, strict: true}: every object closes itself with additionalProperties:false and every property is listed in required. nomor, jumlah, total_nominal and terbilang are computed by the server and must never be taken from model output (spec D3/D4 rule 5). `mata_uang` is recomputed from the locale by the server, so this schema does not tie the two together: a strict `json_schema` request refuses a top-level `anyOf`.

jenis.description: Document type. Field names stay Indonesian for both locales; locale and mata_uang decide what is printed.

locale.description: en -> Quotation / Estimate, USD, amountInWords(). id -> Surat Penawaran, IDR, terbilang().

mata_uang.description: Follows locale: en -> USD, id -> IDR.

nomor.description: Server-made document number: calendar year and a four-digit sequence that resets each year. Never spoken by the user and never invented by the model.

tanggal.description: ISO date the document is issued.

pekerjaan.description: One row per priced item. Every row must cite the turn it came from.

satuan.description: Canonical unit. Adding one is a contract change, not a fixture edit.

sumber_kutipan.description: Turn id (K3) inside the same session, final=true only.

total_nominal.description: Server-computed: the sum of every pekerjaan[].jumlah.

terbilang.description: Server-computed: amountInWords() for en, terbilang() for id.

butuh_konfirmasi.description: Guard findings (K3 payload). A non-empty list holds the document at perlu_konfirmasi.

sumber_kutipan.description: The turn being questioned, or null when the field is simply missing and no turn can be quoted.
